purpose: City-specific discovery of official cadastral parcel sources for Bumba, Democratic Republic of the Congo; claims are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Bumba

queries.query: Bumba Democratic Republic of Congo official cadastral parcel GIS map land registry
queries.result: Search identified the DRC Ministry of Land Affairs jurisdiction directory, the public BIC cadastral map, and general national GIS material. No Bumba parcel geometry service was identified in the returned first-party results.

queries.query: Bumba RDC cadastre parcelles carte SIG circonscription foncière Mongala
queries.result: The official Ministry of Land Affairs directory lists Bumba among the land and cadastral jurisdictions under Mongala. The BIC cadastral map was found, but no anonymous Bumba parcel feature response was established.

officialSources.observation: Current official Ministry of Land Affairs directory identifies Bumba in the Equateur/Mongala listing of land and cadastral jurisdictions. This is local jurisdiction evidence, not parcel geometry or citywide coverage evidence.
Public Bureau d'Informations Cadastrales cadastral-map application was reachable and presents a cadastral map entry point; the anonymous request did not yield a usable Bumba parcel feature response.
Official National Statistics Institute cartography page states that its GIS module is in development; no Bumba cadastral parcel layer was exposed in the observed page.

requests.outcome: Anonymous response contained Bumba in the official list and grouped it with the Mongala province section. No parcel IDs, geometry, schema, or CRS were returned.

Viewer HTML and current JavaScript/configuration were inspected. The public entry point was reachable, but no safe anonymous Bumba ID-plus-geometry response or documented public parcel endpoint was obtained. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or private token was used.
First-party page indicated the GIS module is still in development; no Bumba parcel service or safe parcel response was observed.

registryBasis: The official Ministry of Land Affairs directory explicitly lists Bumba as a land/cadastral jurisdiction. This establishes a local registry custodian/jurisdiction, but not a public parcel geometry API.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Bumba land/cadastral jurisdiction is listed by the DRC Ministry of Land Affairs.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Only jurisdiction-directory evidence was verified; no public parcel geometry was returned.

remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted. BIC may require an authenticated or interactive workflow, and a Bumba-specific cadastral data custodian or service may exist outside the inspected public endpoints. No exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, or unusable viewer is evidence of citywide parcel absence.
